name: YLDS
oneLiner: YLDS is Figure's SEC-registered face-amount certificate paying SOFR-minus-35bps daily interest, backed by short-term Treasuries and repos.
collateral: Short-dated U.S. Treasury bills, overnight Treasury repo, a government money market fund, and cash held by Figure Certificate Company (FCC), an SEC-registered face-amount certificate company; qualified assets are on deposit with UMB Bank N.A. and Flagstar Bank N.A.
pegMechanism: Fixed $1.00 face-amount certificate; daily interest accrual at SOFR minus 35bps (minimum 0%), paid monthly in USD or YLDS; 1:1 mint and redemption through Figure Certificate Company with mandatory KYC; registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and Investment Company Act of 1940

applicabilityBasis.summary: YLDS is a face-amount certificate issued by Figure Certificate Company, registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940 (File No. 811-23913) and the Securities Act of 1933 (File No. 333-275154, effective February 18, 2025). The GENIUS Act (enacted as Public Law 119-27) expressly excludes from the definition of 'payment stablecoin' any digital asset that is a 'security' under the Investment Company Act. Face-amount certificates are a defined category of investment company security under that Act. YLDS therefore falls outside the GENIUS Act's jurisdiction and is exempt from its yield prohibition and PPSI requirements.

mintAuthority.summary: YLDS has independent direct issuance on Solana and Provenance. Solana's standard SPL mint has one externally signable mint authority with no on-chain cap, while the shared SPL Token program is immutable. Provenance marker uylds.fcc has five direct ACCESS_MINT authorities: one zero-delay 4-of-6 group policy and four individual accounts. Chain governance is also enabled for the marker and can change supply controls or native marker logic after the fastest 86,400-second expedited vote.

controls.label: YLDS Solana direct mint authority
controls.capDescription: No configured supply cap beyond the standard SPL Token integer bound.
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 432714278, standard SPL mint 8fr7WGTVFszfyNWRMXj6fRjZZAnDwmXwEpCrtzmUkdih named this on-curve external signer as mintAuthority and separate on-curve signer 8A18H7n3atDfQsN8rLvt98hj5WZJWwhqqR8digDvbia6 as freezeAuthority. The mint key can create arbitrary supply with one signature and no delay. Sixty-six successful post-cutoff mint-touching transactions and no SetAuthority transaction preserve the cutoff state. No address-bound public evidence establishes the legal signer identity or off-chain custody method.

controls.label: YLDS Provenance 4-of-6 marker admin and mint policy
controls.capDescription: Marker supply_fixed is false and marker supply=0 is not a cap. The chain marker module limits total supply to 1,000,000,000,000.000001 YLDS, versus 503,748,076.285525 YLDS outstanding at the cutoff; only chain governance can raise the module limit.
controls.evidence: At Provenance height 32226495, this address held both ACCESS_MINT and ACCESS_ADMIN on marker uylds.fcc. It was self-administered Cosmos group policy 722 with six equal-weight secp256k1 members, a 0.51 threshold requiring four approvals, a 172,800-second voting expiry, and min_execution_period=0. The six members were pb1xak7..., pb108t72..., pb14ujed..., pb1ktgsj..., pb1ue08t..., and pb17fvw.... Execution can occur immediately after the fourth approval; the voting period is not a timelock.

controls.label: Provenance chain governance marker and runtime authority
controls.evidence: At height 32226495, marker uylds.fcc had allow_governance_control=true and marker-module governance enabled. Provenance proposal-handler source permits governance to change marker access and supply and to replace native chain logic through a software-upgrade proposal. The fastest enforced governance path is the 86,400-second expedited voting period; normal voting is 172,800 seconds. Governance can raise the chain marker limits or authorize a different mint surface.

review.evidence: At the fixed cutoff, Solana slot 432714278 and Provenance height 32226495 resolved every tracked mint authority. Solana used one external SPL mint key and immutable shared token code. Provenance marker uylds.fcc was active, restricted, not supply-fixed, and governance-enabled; its exact ACCESS_MINT set was one 4-of-6 group policy plus four individual BaseAccounts. Bank supply was 503,748,076.285525 YLDS and the marker module's chain limit was 1,000,000,000,000.000001 YLDS. Chain governance can change marker supply controls or native runtime after the fastest one-day expedited vote.
